name: Build a Simple House
rationale: Build a simple shelter to protect yourself from monsters at night.
actual: Use blocks to construct a basic house with walls, roof, door, and windows.

plan.action_nl: Collect at least 64 blocks of building material (cobblestone, wood planks, etc.)
plan.expected: At least 64 building blocks in inventory.
plan.notes: Cobblestone is durable and easy to obtain. Wood planks are also good for building.

plan.action_nl: Clear a flat area for the house foundation
plan.expected: Building site is ready.
plan.notes: A 5x5 or 7x7 area is good for a simple house.

plan.action_nl: Place blocks to create a floor and 3-block high walls
plan.expected: Basic house structure with walls.
plan.notes: Leave spaces for door and windows.

plan.action_nl: Place blocks on top for roof and craft/place a door
plan.expected: House with roof and door.
plan.notes: Stairs or slabs make nice roof shapes.

name: Place a Crafting Table
rationale: A Crafting Table is essential for crafting most items in Minecraft.
actual: Craft a Crafting Table and place it in a convenient location.

plan.action_nl: Find and collect at least 1 log from any tree
plan.expected: At least 1 log in inventory.
plan.notes: Any tree type works: oak, birch, spruce, etc.

plan.action_nl: Convert the log into wooden planks
plan.expected: 4 wooden planks in inventory.
plan.notes: Each log produces 4 planks.

plan.action_nl: Use 4 wooden planks to craft a Crafting Table
preconditions: At least 4 wooden planks in inventory
plan.expected: Crafting Table in inventory.
plan.notes: The Crafting Table is placed as a block, not held.

plan.action_nl: Select the Crafting Table and place it on the ground
plan.expected: Crafting Table placed in the world.
plan.notes: Place it somewhere accessible and safe.

name: Build a Simple Tower
rationale: A tall tower provides a vantage point to survey the surrounding area and spot landmarks.
actual: Collect cobblestone and stack blocks vertically to build a 6-block high observation tower.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 12 cobblestone blocks to build the tower pillar
preconditions: Access to stone underground or on surface
plan.expected: At least 12 cobblestone in inventory.
plan.notes: Extra cobblestone is useful for stairs or a platform at the top.

plan.action_nl: Choose a flat, open area to build the tower
plan.expected: Suitable flat location identified.
plan.notes: Build on high ground for maximum visibility.

plan.goal: Stack blocks 6 high to form the tower
plan.action_nl: Jump and place cobblestone blocks vertically to build a 6-block high pillar
plan.expected: A 6-block tall tower standing vertically.
plan.notes: Place blocks while jumping: stand on each new block to place the next one higher. Add a small platform at the top for safety.

name: Build a Defensive Wall
rationale: A defensive wall protects a base area from hostile mobs by blocking their path.
actual: Collect 32 cobblestone and place them in a straight line to create a 2-block high defensive wall.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 32 cobblestone blocks for the wall construction
plan.expected: At least 32 cobblestone in inventory.
plan.notes: A 16-block long wall at 2 blocks high requires 32 cobblestone.

plan.goal: Survey the perimeter to wall off
plan.action_nl: Walk along the area boundary to identify where the wall should go
preconditions: Clear line of sight for planning
plan.expected: Wall path identified.
plan.notes: Choose a straight line along one side of the base.

plan.goal: Place cobblestone in a line to form the wall
plan.action_nl: Place cobblestone blocks side by side in a straight line, two blocks high
plan.expected: A continuous 2-block high wall of cobblestone.
plan.notes: Mobs cannot jump over a 2-block high wall. Make sure there are no gaps.

name: Build a Simple Bridge
rationale: A bridge allows safe crossing over gaps, ravines, or water without falling.
actual: Collect cobblestone and place blocks over a gap to create a walkable bridge.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 20 cobblestone blocks for the bridge construction
plan.expected: At least 20 cobblestone in inventory.
plan.notes: Extra cobblestone allows for railings or a wider bridge.

plan.goal: Position at the edge of the gap
plan.action_nl: Walk to the edge of the ravine or gap to start bridging
plan.expected: Standing at the edge of the gap, ready to bridge.
plan.notes: Be careful not to fall. Crouch (shift) to prevent falling off edges.

plan.action_nl: Sneak to the edge and place cobblestone blocks forward across the gap
plan.expected: A solid cobblestone bridge spanning the gap.
plan.notes: Place blocks while crouching to avoid falling. Place one block forward, step onto it, repeat.

name: Build a Farm Plot
rationale: A farm plot provides a renewable food source by growing crops like wheat, carrots, or potatoes.
actual: Collect wood, craft a hoe, clear an area near water, and till soil to prepare farmland for planting.

plan.action_nl: Chop down trees to collect logs for crafting a hoe and fences
plan.expected: At least 5 logs in inventory.
plan.notes: Logs will be converted to planks and sticks for tools.

plan.action_nl: Convert logs to planks and sticks, then craft a wooden hoe
plan.expected: Wooden hoe crafted and ready.
plan.notes: A hoe is required to till dirt into farmland.

plan.goal: Clear a flat area near water
plan.action_nl: Find a water source and clear grass and flowers from a 9x9 area
preconditions: Water source within 4 blocks of farm site
plan.expected: Flat dirt area adjacent to water, free of grass and plants.
plan.notes: Farmland must be within 4 blocks of water to stay hydrated.

plan.goal: Till the soil with the hoe
plan.action_nl: Equip the wooden hoe and right-click dirt blocks to till them into farmland
plan.expected: Tilled farmland rows ready for planting seeds.
plan.notes: Tilled soil near water turns dark, indicating it is hydrated and ready for crops.

name: Build a Smelting Station
rationale: A smelting station with furnace and chests provides an organized area for cooking food and smelting ores.
actual: Collect cobblestone, craft a furnace and chests, place them together, and organize the workstation.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 8 cobblestone blocks to craft a furnace
plan.expected: At least 8 cobblestone in inventory.
plan.notes: A furnace requires exactly 8 cobblestone to craft.

plan.action_nl: Use 8 cobblestone to craft a furnace at the crafting table
plan.expected: Furnace crafted.
plan.notes: If no crafting table is nearby, craft one from logs first.

plan.action_nl: Find a suitable spot and place the furnace on the ground
plan.expected: Furnace placed and ready to use.
plan.notes: Place the furnace in a well-lit, accessible area.

plan.goal: Craft and place storage chests nearby
plan.action_nl: Collect extra wood, craft chests, and place them next to the furnace for organized storage
plan.expected: Smelting station with furnace and 2 chests for input/output organization.
plan.notes: Use one chest for raw materials (ores, food) and another for smelted outputs.

name: Build a Storage Room
rationale: A dedicated storage room with organized chests keeps items sorted and easy to find.
actual: Collect wood, craft multiple chests, clear a room, place chests in rows, and label them by category.

plan.goal: Collect wood for chests and room construction
plan.action_nl: Chop down trees to collect at least 20 logs for crafting chests and building walls
plan.expected: At least 20 logs in inventory.
plan.notes: Each chest requires 8 planks (2 logs). Plan for 6-8 chests plus building material.

plan.action_nl: Convert logs to planks and craft 8 chests for storage
plan.expected: 8 chests crafted and in inventory.
plan.notes: Two chests placed next to each other form a double chest with double capacity.

plan.action_nl: Dig out or clear a room at least 5x5x3 blocks in size
plan.expected: An enclosed room with flat floor and walls.
plan.notes: A 5x5x3 room can fit 4 double chests along one wall with walking space.

plan.action_nl: Place chests side by side along the walls to form double chests
plan.expected: Chests placed in neat rows along the walls.
plan.notes: Leave a 1-block gap between chest rows for walking access.

plan.goal: Label and organize chests by category
plan.action_nl: Add signs above each chest to label categories (ores, food, tools, building, misc)
plan.expected: Labeled storage room with categories for easy item sorting.
plan.notes: Suggested categories: Ores/Ingots, Food, Tools/Weapons, Building Blocks, Redstone, Misc.

name: Build a Nether Portal
rationale: A Nether Portal provides access to the Nether dimension for rare resources like nether quartz, blaze rods, and ancient debris.
actual: Collect obsidian with a diamond pickaxe, build a 4x5 portal frame, and light it with Flint and Steel.

plan.goal: Collect obsidian with a diamond pickaxe
plan.action_nl: First obtain a diamond pickaxe, then mine at least 10 obsidian blocks from lava-water intersections
preconditions: Access to deep underground for diamonds
Iron pickaxe or better for mining diamond ore
Water bucket to create obsidian from lava
Diamond pickaxe required (obsidian breaks too slowly with other tools)
plan.expected: 10 obsidian blocks and a diamond pickaxe in inventory.
plan.notes: Obsidian forms when flowing water touches lava source blocks. Mining obsidian takes ~10 seconds with diamond pickaxe. Do NOT use any other pickaxe — the block will break without dropping.

plan.action_nl: Place obsidian blocks in a vertical 4-wide by 5-tall rectangle, leaving the center hollow
preconditions: Flat ground for the portal base
plan.expected: A hollow obsidian frame 4 blocks wide and 5 blocks tall.
plan.notes: The minimum portal is 4x5 (corners optional). Bottom: 4 wide, sides: 3 high each, top: 4 wide. Only 10 obsidian needed if corners are omitted.

plan.goal: Craft Flint and Steel and light the portal
plan.action_nl: Craft Flint and Steel from iron ingot and flint, then right-click the portal frame interior to ignite it
plan.expected: Nether portal lit with purple swirl effect inside the frame.
plan.notes: Flint drops from mining gravel (10% chance). The portal will emit a purple particle effect and a portal sound when lit successfully.

name: Build a Simple Mob Trap
rationale: A mob trap automatically damages and kills hostile mobs to collect their drops safely.
actual: Collect materials, dig a pit, set up water flows, add signs to control water, and create a dark spawning room above.

plan.action_nl: Gather cobblestone, signs, water buckets, and building blocks for the trap
preconditions: Iron ingot for bucket (if no bucket)
plan.expected: At least 64 cobblestone and 10 logs in inventory.
plan.notes: You will also need signs (from planks + sticks) and a water bucket. Craft these from the collected materials.

plan.action_nl: Dig a 2-block deep pit where mob drops will collect
plan.expected: A 2-block deep pit dug into the ground.
plan.notes: The pit should be at the bottom of the trap where items will collect. Make it at least 3x3.

plan.goal: Add water flows to push mobs down
plan.action_nl: Place water source blocks at the top of channels to create flowing water that pushes mobs toward the pit
preconditions: Water source nearby to fill bucket
plan.expected: Water flowing from all sides toward the central pit.
plan.notes: Water flows can carry mobs up to 8 blocks. Place water sources at opposite corners of the spawning floor.

plan.goal: Add signs to control water flow
plan.action_nl: Place signs at the edges of the pit to stop water from flowing into the collection area
plan.expected: Signs blocking water from entering the item collection pit.
plan.notes: Signs act as water barriers. Place them on the walls around the pit edge to stop water flow.

plan.goal: Create a dark spawning room above
plan.action_nl: Build an enclosed dark room above the water channels for mobs to spawn in
preconditions: Water channels and pit already built below
plan.expected: A fully enclosed dark room above the trap where mobs spawn and fall into water.
plan.notes: The room must be completely dark (no light sources) and enclosed. Hostile mobs spawn in darkness. Build it at least 3 blocks high.

plan.goal: Add a drop chute and collection point
plan.action_nl: Create a fall chute from the dark room down to the pit so mobs take fall damage
preconditions: Pit and water flows ready below
plan.expected: Mobs spawn in dark room, get pushed by water, fall down chute, and die in pit.
plan.notes: A fall of 22-23 blocks kills most mobs. Stand near the collection pit to pick up drops safely.
